rules.title: Source-of-income and housing subsidy discrimination (c.151B s.4(10))
rules.requirement: It is unlawful to furnish rental accommodations to discriminate against a person because they receive public assistance or housing subsidies such as rental assistance, or because of a requirement of such a program.
rules.key_value: No refusal based on public assistance or housing subsidy (e.g. vouchers)
rules.coverage_conditions: Any person furnishing credit, services or rental accommodations
rules.exemptions: No exemption stated for this paragraph in the text
rules.quoted_span: to discriminate against any individual who is a recipient of federal, state, or local public assistance, including medical assistance
rules.interaction: State fair housing floor; local source-of-income rules may add to it.

notes: c.151B s.4 is long and mostly covers employment and protected-class discrimination (out of scope); only para 10 fits screening_restrictions. No criminal-history rule for housing in this text (para 9 1/2 is employment). No effective date in text.
